notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content: [h2]General[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Ukrainian language localization added.[/p][/*][*][p]A sleep option and a new associated number have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Emergency service numbers have been added.[/p][p][i](There is usually a moratorium on such numbers, but players try to call them anyway, so they are included)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Localization errors in some texts have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Other improvements and fixes. [/p][/*][/list]
